semantic_changes: Driving the protocol without tick() means BLE heartbeats and resend timers never fire; that is deliberate so the reconnection path is the only recovery trigger.
Events are emitted as single-line CA_EVENT JSON objects on stdout; SAMPLE carries the case and phase so both cases in one execution stay separable.

scope.description: Two cases in one execution over three real OmniPaxos instances in one process with MemoryStorage and a deterministic FIFO in-process network: (resync) re-established connections to the leader after a decided StopSign, (control) identical prefix without reconnected(). Only public API calls drive the protocol; every observation is one CA_EVENT JSON line on stdout.
assumptions: Entry type Value has Snapshot = NoSnapshot, so T::Snapshot::use_snapshots() is false and create_log_sync takes its no-snapshot branch.
ClusterConfig { configuration_id: 1, nodes: [1,2,3], flexible_quorum: None } (majority 2) and default ServerConfig (batch_size 1, no batching).
Leadership is established with the public try_become_leader() on node 3; BLE heartbeat messages are dropped because no tick() is called.
All SequencePaxos messages are delivered in FIFO order without loss, so the reconnection and re-synchronization is the only deviation from a healthy run.
Case labels in the events ('case') keep the resync and control streams distinguishable.
excluded: Snapshots, trimming and compaction are not exercised; batching is disabled (batch_size 1).
No crate or package test suite is executed; only the generated test file.

basis.prefix: Cluster::new() builds OmniPaxos<Value, MemoryStorage<Value>> for pids 1,2,3 (validated OmniPaxosConfig). run_prefix(): node 3 calls try_become_leader(); the FIFO pump drains Prepare/Promise/AcceptSync/Accepted until quiet (SAMPLE phase leader_elected); node 3 appends Value(0..4) and the pump drains AcceptDecide/Accepted/Decide until quiet (phase entries_decided); node 3 calls reconfigure(ClusterConfig{configuration_id: 2, nodes:[1,2,3]}, None) and the pump drains AcceptStopSign/Accepted/Decide until quiet (phase stopsign_decided). Case resync then calls node1.reconnected(3) and node2.reconnected(3) and pumps to quiet; case control only pumps again. Each SAMPLE line reports node, accepted_idx (get_accepted_idx), decided_idx (get_decided_idx), decided_eq_accepted, is_reconfigured(), read(5), and read_decided_suffix(0) (state plus entry count).
basis.responsibility: Target-internal bookkeeping: SequencePaxos::create_log_sync plus InternalStorage::sync_log decide what a re-synchronized replica's accepted index and carried StopSign are; the caller only reports a re-established connection through the public reconnected() API and never supplies log indices or StopSign state.

comparisons.description: Before any reconnection each replica reports the StopSign as decided.
Before any reconnection decided index equals accepted index on each replica.
After both followers report re-established connections the leader still reports the reconfiguration as decided.
The leader's reported decided index is still covered by the entries it holds after the re-synchronizations.
The leader's decided log stays readable from index 0.
A re-synchronized follower's decided log read from index 0 still contains the five decided entries plus the StopSign.
Control: without reconnection the reconfiguration stays reported as decided.
Control: without reconnection the decided log read from index 0 contains the five entries plus the StopSign.
